title: CI's required checks cannot pass by being skipped, and protection has one source
description: roles has no aggregator, so a skipped roles satisfies the requirement; branch protection lives in both a ruleset and a classic rule that can drift; a pull request touching .github/ or test/**/*.sh is first exercised in the queue; any label restarts a pull request's run.
acceptanceCriteria: roles gets the same decide step as integration and e2e, which fails when its job was skipped for a reason other than a docs-only change
Branch protection is the ruleset alone; the classic rule is removed
A pull request touching .github/ or test/**/*.sh runs the media tiers as ci:full does, and only the ci:full label restarts a run
source: Fable 5.2 CI review, 2026-11-12 (.results/ci-review-2026-11-12.md); owner approved A, B, C, D and the later items
notes: D-069: BL-269 comes to triage before criterion 1 is built. Dropped (D-126 and the pivot, D-107): Rule 14: no failure seen now. Moved to the backlog; JS-175 brings it back if a skipped check is found to have let a failure through.
